review:
Cheetah Wild is a safari money-collect slot. Wilds on reels two to four can carry multipliers up to 3x, and several in one win multiply together. A collect symbol on the first reel pays the values of adjacent money symbols and wilds, boosted by any wild multipliers in that combination; money symbols are worth up to 100x.

Three to five scatters award 8 to 20 free spins, with retriggers of 5 to 20 more. During the bonus, Level Up symbols fill a meter and turn into money symbols. Collecting 4, 7, 13 and 15 of them unlocks levels where chosen high-paying symbols become money symbols for the rest of the round; at level five every premium does. Published RTP is 96.50%. It suits fans of collect features.
